summary: Crash when setting LodestonePos of compass to something other than NBT compound
description: The bug The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos having a value other than an NBT compound tag. [ (20w17a) crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la at bhr.a(SourceFile:144) at bje.a(SourceFile:454) at bcw.j(SourceFile:290) at bcx.l(SourceFile:575) at anz.h(SourceFile:2217) at bcx.h(SourceFile:274) at ys.i(SourceFile:411) at zj.b(SourceFile:199) at ma.a(SourceFile:234) at zi.c(SourceFile:171) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:839) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:766) at enn.a(SourceFile:89) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.run(SourceFile:625) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) How to reproduce Do this in a test world give s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"} The game freezes and you will see in the log file that it has crashed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 20w17a.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Open the chat window and type the following command: `/give @p compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}` and press Enter.
4. Pick up the compass that appears in your inventory.
5. Observe that the game freezes.
6. Check the log file for a crash report, specifically `crash-reports/*.txt` to confirm the crash.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos value that is not an NBT compound tag. This issue occurs in version 20w17a, as evidenced by the crash log file from April 23, 2020. The specific error message indicates a `java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la` at `bhr.a(SourceFile:144)`. To reproduce this bug, in a test world, use the command `/give s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`. The game will freeze and crash, with the log file showing the crash details. This behavior highlights that the LodestonePos must be formatted as a valid NBT compound for the game to function correctly without crashing.
Expected Behavior: When a compass is given with a `LodestonePos` value that is not an NBT compound, the game should not crash. Instead, it should either ignore the invalid data or display an error message indicating that the provided `LodestonePos` must be a valid NBT compound tag. The player should remain in the game without any unexpected interruptions or freezes.
